slides.h: The caption archive got a third repair route
b: Re-transcription fixes vocabulary. The glossary fixes names. Source alignment beats both — where a source survives.

b: 48 of 152 backfilled captions narrate a document that still exists — authored text, not machine text.

slides.h: My own thresholds discarded both proven pairs
b: Garbled audio breaks word-matching, so real sources score low.
The bands are now set by the proven pairs — 0.239 and 0.078 — not by intuition.

b: The name list is a no-op — both transcribers faithfully record names the TTS mispronounced. Caught after commit, corrected in the next.
